title: Langfuse Secret API key: one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: UUID variant nibble 7, outside the 8/9/a/b RFC 4122 variant and alphabet: UUID version nibble 5 instead of the 4 the key generator mints. Twin of "Langfuse Secret API key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of langfuse-secret-key-twin-base-dotenv: alphabet: UUID version nibble 5 instead of the 4 the key generator mints. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
